morpy.grid_run module¶

Module¶

Grid orchestration for multi-model execution.

This module provides: - run_models_local: local parallel orchestration using existing launch/wait APIs. - run_models_mpi: simple rank-split parallel execution using mpi4py. - run_models: backend dispatcher.

Design goals: - Keep behavior consistent with run.py by delegating per-model execution there. - Keep orchestration simple (FIFO queue, bounded concurrency). - Remain compatible with observer-based persistence/status adapters.

morpy.grid_run.run_grid(items, *, backend='local', max_workers=1, queue_policy='fifo', sync_before_run=True, default_options=None, config=None, allow_unknown_options=False, command_name='rn', log_file_name='log.out', capture_output=True, timeout=None, tracker=None, resume_policy=None)[source]

Run a grid of models with local workers or MPI.

Dispatches to run_models_local or run_models_mpi based on backend.

Parameters:

  • items (Iterable[GridRunItem]) – GridRunItem values for models to run.

  • backend (Literal['local', 'mpi']) – local for subprocess-based execution, mpi for mpi4py execution.

  • max_workers (int) – Maximum parallel workers for local backend.

  • queue_policy (Literal['fifo']) – Queue policy (currently fifo only).

  • sync_before_run (bool) – Sync model inlists from disk before each launch.

  • default_options (DefaultsOptions | None) – Parsed defaults used during sync_before_run.

  • config (MesaConfig | None) – MesaConfig object.

  • allow_unknown_options (bool) – Whether unknown inlist options are tolerated during sync.

  • command_name (str) – Run script name, typically rn or re.

  • log_file_name (str) – Log-file name written by run scripts.

  • capture_output (bool) – Whether to capture stdout/stderr in results.

  • timeout (float | None) – Optional timeout in seconds.

  • tracker (Tracker | None) – Optional persistence/live-status tracker.

  • resume_policy (ResumePolicy | None) – Optional repository-based resume policy.

Returns:

GridRunResult with per-model results and aggregate counts.

Return type:

GridRunResult

morpy.grid_run.run_models_local(items, *, max_workers, queue_policy='fifo', sync_before_run=True, default_options=None, config=None, allow_unknown_options=False, command_name='rn', log_file_name='log.out', capture_output=True, timeout=None, tracker=None, stop_event=None, running_processes=None, running_lock=None)[source]

Run many models locally with limit on parallel runs.

Uses launch_model + wait_for_model so model lifecycle and observer behaviour remains aligned with single-model runs.

Parameters:

  • items (list[GridRunItem]) – list of GridRunItem objects containing the models to run.

  • queue_policy (QueuePolicy) – QueyePolicy type. Currently only ‘fifo’ (= First In, First Out) available.

  • max_workers (int) – Maximum number of models to run in parallel. WARNING: make sure that OMP_NUM_THREADS x max_workers does not exceed your machine’s number of available threads.

  • sync_before_run (bool) – If True (default), the function calls work_setup.sync_model_with_disk to update the inlist attributes of Model in case the user made any changes to the inlist files themselves. This ensures that the inlist files themselves remain the ground truth.

  • default_options (DefaultsOptions | None) – DefaultOptions object. Should be passed if sync_before_run == True.

  • config (MesaConfig | None) – MesaConfig object. Will be reconstructed on the fly if not passed.

  • allow_unknown_options (bool) – If True, give a warning about inlist options that are not found in the defaults files when syncing Model.inlists with inlists in the model directory. If False, raise an exception when inlist options are found that are not found in the defaults files.

  • command_name (str) – Name of the “rn” script. Can be used for restarts by specifying “re” or can be used for custom-named “rn” scripts.

  • capture_output (bool) – If True, capture stdout/stderr and include them in RunResult. If False, wait without collecting output (stdout/stderr in result are empty strings).

  • timeout (float | None) – Maximum time in seconds to wait before aborting. If exceeded, the process is killed and RunTimeoutError is raised.

  • tracker (Tracker | None) – Optional Tracker object for in-memory information through tracker.live_tracker and StateTransitions via the tracker.observer

  • log_file_name (str)

  • stop_event (threading.Event | None)

  • running_processes (dict[str, tuple[GridRunItem, RunHandle, subprocess.Popen]] | None)

  • running_lock (threading.Lock | None)

Returns:

GridRunResult

Return type:

GridRunResult

morpy.grid_run.run_models_mpi(items, *, queue_policy='fifo', sync_before_run=True, default_options=None, config=None, allow_unknown_options=False, command_name='rn', log_file_name='log.out', capture_output=True, timeout=None, tracker=None)[source]

Run many models distributed across MPI ranks.

Work distribution is simple round-robin by rank for predictability.

Should be run as mpirun -n <<MAX_WORKERS>> python mr_script.py or srun -n <<MAX_WORKERS>> python mr_script.py, where <<MAX_WORKERS>> is an integer number equivalent to max_workers in run_models_local.

Parameters:

  • items (list[GridRunItem]) – list of GridRunItem objects containing the models to run.

  • queue_policy (Literal['fifo']) – QueyePolicy type. Currently only ‘fifo’ (=First In, First Out) available.

  • sync_before_run (bool) – If True (default), the function calls work_setup.sync_model_with_disk to update the inlist attributes of Model in case the user made any changes to the inlist files themselves. This ensures that the inlist files themselves remain the ground truth.

  • default_options (DefaultsOptions | None) – DefaultOptions object. Should be passed if sync_before_run == True.

  • config (MesaConfig | None) – MesaConfig object. Will be reconstructed on the fly if not passed.

  • allow_unknown_options (bool) – If True, give a warning about inlist options that are not found in the defaults files when syncing Model.inlists with inlists in the model directory. If False, raise an exception when inlist options are found that are not found in the defaults files.

  • command_name (str) – Name of the “rn” script. Can be used for restarts by specifying “re” or can be used for custom-named “rn” scripts.

  • capture_output (bool) – If True, capture stdout/stderr and include them in RunResult. If False, wait without collecting output (stdout/stderr in result are empty strings).

  • timeout (float | None) – Maximum time in seconds to wait before aborting. If exceeded, the process is killed and RunTimeoutError is raised.

  • tracker (Tracker | None) – Optional Tracker object for in-memory information through tracker.live_tracker and StateTransitions via the tracker.observer

morpy.grid_run.stop_grid(handle=None, *, tracker=None, force=True, grace_seconds=3.0, recover_from_dbfile=True, restart=False)[source]

Stop a launched grid in live mode and/or repository recovery mode.

Behavior:

  • If handle is provided, performs live-session cooperative cancellation.

  • If recover_from_dbfile=True and tracker is available, performs best-effort recovery cancellation using all active models in the DB.

Note

In this project design, one DB file corresponds to one grid context, so repository recovery targets all active models in that DB.

Parameters:

  • handle (GridRunHandle | None)

  • tracker (Tracker | None)

  • force (bool)

  • grace_seconds (float)

  • recover_from_dbfile (bool)

  • restart (bool)

Return type:

dict[str, object]
